QUESTIONS

What people ask before they message.

What does Jwero’s jewellery MIS reports & dashboard software do?

Jewellery MIS reports and dashboards: ask a question and AI builds the report, pin it to an owner’s dashboard on your phone, schedule it, export to Excel. Sales, stock ageing, schemes, receivables and staff across every branch. It is part of Jwero One: ₹18,000 a month, every module included, with the first month at ₹3,600.

What is MIS for a jewellery business?

Management information: the reports an owner uses to run the business, such as sales, stock ageing, scheme dues and receivables. Jwero builds them from one record, across every branch.

Which reports should a jewellery owner see daily?

Yesterday’s sales by branch, stock ageing, scheme collections due, receivables, and walk-ins against sales. Pin them to the owner’s dashboard.

Do I need to know how to build reports?

No. Type the question and AI drafts the report’s source, filters and chart. Adjust, save and pin.

Can I see reports on my phone?

Yes. The owner’s dashboard works on mobile.

Can reports be scheduled?

Yes. Schedule a report and it is delivered on its own, every day, week or month.

Can I export to Excel?

Yes. Excel, CSV and PDF.

Who can see what?

Reports follow roles: a branch manager sees her branch, head office sees all, and finance and payroll stay with the roles that own them.

Will my accountant use this?

Your books sync to Tally for the accountant; these reports are for running the business day to day.
